System

Biome servers, loading screens and fenced handoff

A player walks through a registered road gate and connects to a different server process while other players remain in the source zone. Internal world streaming can reduce one map's memory use but cannot perform this identity/session handoff.

Scope and player interaction

A player walks through a registered road gate and connects to a different server process while other players remain in the source zone. Internal world streaming can reduce one map's memory use but cannot perform this identity/session handoff.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase06committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Idle → ValidatingGate → DrainingCommands → ReservingDestination → TicketReady → Connecting → Hydrating → Complete → RecoveryRequired

WBP_Loading observes results from URPGZoneTransferComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Zone_Rillmere. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
GateId: stable authored ID; SourceZoneId, DestinationZoneId, DestinationEntranceId
TransferId UUID; SourceEpoch bigint; DestinationEpoch=SourceEpoch+1 on redemption
SnapshotRevision: last accepted durable character revision
DestinationReservationId and CapacityExpiryUtc: backend-managed
SignedTicketClaims: issuer,audience,account,character,transfer,destination,revision,expiry,nonce
TicketUsed: one-use backend record; signature alone is not replay prevention

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGZoneTransferComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_LoadingLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
RequestZoneTransfer(CommandId, GateId) -> Preparing|InCombat|InvalidDestination|ZoneFull
PrepareTransfer(CharacterId, Epoch, Revision, Destination) -> ReservationAndTicket|Rejected; backend proposal
RedeemTransfer(TransferId, SignedTicket, IdentityProof) -> NewEpochSnapshot|AlreadyUsed|Expired
AcknowledgeArrival(TransferId, Epoch) -> Completed; backend/source cleanup notification
RecoverTransfer(CharacterId) -> ResumeDestination|ReturnSafeHub|WaitForLease

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Player interaction reaches source server; verify gate actor, range/LOS, destination/return entrance, character eligibility and no disallowed combat/death state.
  2. Freeze new economic starts and drain/reconcile accepted commands. Persist current accepted snapshot with expected revision; never serialize a client UI inventory.
  3. Backend reserves a destination instance with free capacity and records Preparing transfer state under the current fenced character lease. On failure unfreeze source safely.
  4. Create a short-lived signed ticket bound to account, character, destination and revision. Deliver it through the authenticated session channel; avoid placing bearer credentials in logs or long-lived URLs.
  5. Source instructs only the owning controller to ClientTravel to the allocated server endpoint using absolute travel. A loading screen spans disconnect/connect; other controllers do not travel.
  6. Destination validates identity/ticket/reservation, then atomically consumes the ticket and changes session ownership/epoch in the backend. Old source writes immediately become fenced, even before visual acknowledgement.
  7. Destination loads the agreed snapshot, spawns one body guarded by CharacterId+epoch, restores persistent facts without replaying grants, and enables input only after hydration/possession readiness.
  8. Arrival acknowledgement retires the frozen source body and reservation. If destination crashes after redemption, recovery obtains a later epoch; it never reuses a consumed token or reactivates old authority.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Author DA_Zone_Rillmere and DA_Zone_Thornweald with exact map soft paths and entrance IDs. Place BP_ZoneGate actors as Gate_East and Gate_West with reciprocal links and safe spawn transforms away from overlap retrigger.
  2. Run separate Server_A and Server_B processes on different game ports. Register both with the same development backend; do not use whole-server ServerTravel to test a single-player gate.
  3. Create WBP_Loading through the process-local client screen/session owner, not the source pawn. Its state persists while that pawn/controller is replaced.
  4. Reopen BP_RPGPlayerController: clear held input and close dialogue/vendor/craft contexts on Prepare; route connection/network failure to RecoverTransfer. The backend decides the safe next destination.
  5. Use the engine ClientTravel API for an external connection. Transition maps/seamless ServerTravel are for moving a server's clients together; streaming cells stay within a server world. Exact secure admission transport must be verified in installed engine/provider configuration.
  6. Add fixtures for full destination, expired reservation, duplicate ticket, stale snapshot, source crash before redemption and destination crash after redemption.

Reopen Phase06 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / Gate_East / L_Thornweald / Gate_West / Server_A / Server_B. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Client_A travels while Client_B remains -> A arrives at Gate_West, B stays in Rillmere and Server_A remains alive.
Source crash before redeem -> backend resolves Preparing state and reconnects with one valid lease, no lost committed craft.
Duplicate ticket -> AlreadyUsed; no second pawn or reward replay.
Destination full -> ZoneFull before departure when possible; source unfreezes or recovery sends to safe hub with a new valid reservation.
Old source tries to sell after redemption -> SessionFenced and no ledger entry.
NPC UI reply arrives after travel -> ignored by generation/zone check; never opens an old merchant in the new zone.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Proposed ticket TTL 60 seconds and reservation TTL 90 seconds. Spawn cooldown/offset prevents portal ping-pong. These require latency and capacity measurements; loading screens do not imply instant distributed atomicity.

Trace TransferId across source, backend and destination. Record prepare/redeem/hydrate/ack timestamps, epoch and revision. Keep signatures/tickets out of ordinary logs; require secure admission transport before public deployment.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
